head.title: Plant Based Catering Dubai — What to Expect | myCHEF Dubai
head.meta_description: Plant based catering in Dubai: what a plant-led menu actually looks like, how it is sourced and priced, and what to ask before you book.
head.h1: Plant Based Catering Dubai — What to Expect

opening_paragraph: Plant based catering in Dubai costs from AED 700 per person. Here is the honest version. Vegan catering in Dubai delivers fully plant-based menus, no meat, dairy or eggs, from around AED 700 per person, so your vegan guests get a real spread instead of a side salad. With myCHEF you get the same chefs, cooking and service as any other menu.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What does plant-based catering in Dubai include?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What does plant-based catering in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: It covers a full meal, not a garnish. Good plant-based catering in Dubai runs across mezze, curries, wok dishes, grazing boards, a vegan buffet and proper desserts, so the food feels generous instead of apologetic. Dubai has the pantry for it. The city's plant-based dining scene has widened fast, and industry write-ups from Foodics point to dedicated Dubai kitchens such as Seva Table and Planet Terra, alongside long-standing vegetarian spots like My Govinda's, established in 2001. That breadth means a vegan caterer here can lean on Levantine, South Indian, East Asian and Mediterranean traditions that were plant-forward long before the label existed. The result is a menu that carries a whole event on its own.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Is vegan food in demand in Dubai now?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Is vegan food in demand in Dubai now?
new_paragraphs: Yes, and the numbers back it up. Regional survey data cited by the Middle East Vegan Society reports that 87% of UAE respondents have tried plant-based food and beverages, and that grocery sales of plant-based products rose 54% over three years. The same body projects the wider MENA plant-based market to reach USD 8 to 9 billion by 2030. Foodics adds that the GCC vegan food market is forecast to grow at an 11% compound annual rate between 2025 and 2033. For a host, the practical upshot is clear: a plant-based table no longer reads as niche, and asking for vegan event catering in Dubai is now a normal request, not an awkward one.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: What goes on a vegan menu for a Dubai event?
replace_in_block.new_heading: What goes on a vegan menu for a Dubai event?
new_paragraphs: Think in stations and courses. A popular vegan menu in Dubai opens with a grazing board of dips, breads and marinated vegetables, moves through a mezze spread or a live wok or pasta station, and lands on either a shared buffet or a plated tasting. A plant based menu in Dubai leans hard on flavour: harissa-roasted cauliflower, jackfruit, silky dhal, charred aubergine, sesame noodles. Matteo Moretti handles the dessert-led finish, because vegan pastry, from dark-chocolate tarts to sorbet, is where a lot of guests are quietly won over. Everything is built to your guest count, so a vegan buffet for a big party and a four-course tasting for six draw on the same kitchen.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Can a vegan private chef cook at my home or villa?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Can a vegan private chef cook at my home or villa?
new_paragraphs: Yes, on site and start to finish. A vegan private chef in Dubai builds the menu around your tastes, plus any extra needs you flag such as gluten-free or nut-free, then cooks and serves at your home, villa or venue. For Mediterranean and Levantine plant-based cooking, Marco Rossi is a natural fit; for a formal plated dinner, Ahmed Al-Rashid runs the pass. This is the same private-chef model myCHEF uses for any cuisine, only fully plant-based. You are not booking a drop-off tray, you are booking a chef who plates in your kitchen and clears down after. See our vegan catering and private chef pages for how it runs.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How much does vegan catering in Dubai cost?
replace_in_block.new_heading: How much does vegan catering in Dubai cost?
new_paragraphs: Budget from around AED 700 per person. Vegan catering prices in Dubai track the same drivers as any menu: number of courses, service style, chef and guest count. A grazing or buffet-style spread typically starts near AED 700 per person, a fuller plated tasting rises from about AED 1,400 per person, and a premium multi-course dinner with a dedicated chef sits higher again. There is no vegan surcharge baked in; plant ingredients are not the cost, the cooking and service are. For an exact figure, share your date, headcount and venue and you get an itemised proposal, usually within one business day. Our vegan catering page and the catering in Dubai hub set out packages in more detail.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Is vegan catering safe, hygienic and halal?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Is vegan catering safe, hygienic and halal?
new_paragraphs: It is held to the same food-safety bar as any catered meal. Catering in Dubai operates under the Dubai Food Code enforced by Dubai Municipality , which covers hygiene, storage and allergen handling. Guidance summarised by food-safety advisers notes that food handlers complete certified training of roughly four to eight hours on personal hygiene, temperature control and cross-contamination, backed by HACCP records. Fully vegan food carries no animal products at all, so it is inherently halal in composition, and myCHEF chefs flag allergens such as gluten, soy and nuts on request. Confirm current rules with the official sources.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Does it scale to weddings and big parties?
replace_in_block.new_heading: Does it scale to weddings and big parties?
new_paragraphs: Comfortably. Vegan wedding catering and vegan party catering in Dubai scale from a twelve-seat villa dinner to a large event buffet without losing the plot. For a crowd, grazing tables and live stations keep things moving; for a wedding, a plated plant-based tasting reads as a considered choice, not a compromise. Because a good spread holds its own, it also anchors a mixed-diet event: vegan and non-vegan guests eat from one generous table instead of being split off. If you want the fully plant route or a hybrid, the vegan and vegetarian catering pages both apply. This is also a genuinely healthy catering option when you want lighter, vegetable-led food.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: How does myCHEF vet its chefs?
replace_in_block.new_heading: How does myCHEF vet its chefs?
new_paragraphs: Carefully, and before anyone cooks for you. Every myCHEF chef goes through identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing reviews of real bookings. For plant-based work that matters, because vegan cooking rewards technique: getting texture, depth and satisfaction without butter, cream or stock is a skill, not a substitution. Layla Hassan covers Arabic and Levantine tables, Marco Rossi the Mediterranean, Matteo Moretti the pastry, and Ahmed Al-Rashid the fine-dining plated menus. You can read the full vegan catering options or start a brief at contact .

We arrange plant based catering across the whole of Dubai — Downtown and Business Bay apartments, Palm Jumeirah and Emirates Hills villas, Marina and JBR rooftops, out to Dubai Hills and Arabian Ranches — with the chef, kit and team travelling to your kitchen, so “plant based catering near me” comes down to your date rather than your postcode. Want the best vegan catering in Dubai for your event, or just an exact quote? Vegan Catering · Vegetarian · Private Chef . Or start at private chef or catering in Dubai .

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: Planning vegan catering step by step
replace_in_block.new_heading: Planning vegan catering step by step
new_paragraphs: Send your date, guest count and venue — your vegan catering proposal arrives.
Book vegan catering about 2 weeks ahead off-peak, and 6 weeks ahead between November and March.
Confirm the vegan catering menu roughly 7 days before, once your numbers settle.
Ask about dietary covers for vegan catering when you enquire, not inside the final 48 hours .
Check venue access and parking for vegan catering; the team arrives about 2 hours before service.
Plan on roughly 3 hours of vegan catering service, and add 5% VAT to the total.
What is vegan catering in Dubai?
Vegan catering in Dubai is a fully plant-based service with no meat, dairy or eggs, built from Asian, Mediterranean, Indian and Levantine cooking so guests get a full spread, not a token salad.
How much does vegan catering cost in Dubai?

Vegan catering prices in Dubai start from around AED 700 per person for a grazing or buffet spread, with plated tasting menus rising from about AED 1,400 per person, depending on courses, chef and service.
Is vegan food popular in Dubai?
Yes. Survey data cited by the Middle East Vegan Society reports 87% of UAE respondents have tried plant-based food and beverages, and grocery sales rose 54% over three years.
Can you cater a mixed vegan and non-vegan event?
Yes. A strong plant-based spread stands on its own and also anchors a mixed-diet event, so vegan and non-vegan guests eat from the same table.
Do you offer a vegan private chef at home?
Yes. A vegan private chef builds the menu around your tastes, cooks on site at your home, villa or venue, and serves it exactly as they would any other menu.
Is the food halal and allergen-aware?
Fully vegan food contains no animal products, so it is inherently halal in composition, and myCHEF chefs flag allergens such as gluten, soy and nuts on request.
Can vegan catering work for a wedding?
Yes. Vegan wedding and event catering scales from an intimate villa dinner to a large buffet, with grazing tables, live stations and a dessert-led finish.
Does Dubai cater for vegans?

Yes, and far better than it did five years ago. Dubai is a vegan-friendly city with dedicated plant-based restaurant kitchens, vegan menus in mainstream venues and plant-based ranges in the supermarkets; the Middle East Vegan Society reports 87% of UAE respondents have tried plant-based food and drink. For catering the practical test is narrower: ask whether the kitchen cooks plant-based every week or only when someone asks for it.
Do Emirates do vegan meals?

Yes. Emirates lets you request a vegan special meal in advance through your booking or Manage Your Booking, and asks for it a set number of hours before departure — check the airline's own special-meals page for the current cut-off, since it is their rule, not ours. It is a different question from event catering, but it is the same underlying one: plant-based food in the UAE now has to be requested rather than negotiated.
What is the leading catering company in Dubai?

No single company leads it, and for plant-based work the ranking that matters is narrower than the general one. Ask three things of any shortlist: does the kitchen cook vegan food regularly or improvise it, are per-head prices published or only quoted on request, and do you find out who is cooking before the day. MyCHEF publishes its per-head figures on this page and names the chef on the brief, which is the part most hosts want settled.

Food safety and licensing in Dubai are governed by official authorities: see Dubai Municipality and the Dubai food-safety overview . Market and dining context is drawn from the Middle East Vegan Society and Foodics . Confirm current requirements with the official sources.
Request an itemised proposal or start on WhatsApp .
